title: SEO Metadata
description: The shared SEO block — <title>, meta description, keywords, Open Graph overrides, canonical URL and robots flags. Mixed into any content type that owns a URL (page, blog article, product) via a root-level allOf, so a new SEO field lands in one place. Copy here is deliberately type-agnostic: a consuming type overrides an individual field's title or description alongside the $ref where it has something more specific to say.

description.title: Description
description.description: Meta description — search snippets and social previews.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Meta keywords. Low SEO weight today, but cheap to carry.

social.title: Social card
social.description: Open Graph overrides. Unset fields fall back to this item's own title and description.

canonicalUrl.title: Canonical URL
canonicalUrl.description: Rarely set — when absent, the canonical defaults to this item's own route.

robots.title: Robots
robots.description: Absent flags mean indexable and followable — editors opt out, never in.
